source: Documentation requirements agreed with Sunpeak Foods BV (contracted lane: Nhava Sheva -> Rotterdam, Basmati rice programme). In production this file is owned by the CG team lead and versioned; the agent only ever reads it.

rules.label: Consignee must read 'Sunpeak Foods BV' (punctuation variants like 'B.V.' accepted)
HS code must be 1006.30 - semi-milled or wholly milled rice. Any other code risks a customs hold at Rotterdam.
Contract terms are CIF Rotterdam - invoice must state CIF
Invoicing currency is USD per the purchase contract
Port of discharge must be Rotterdam
Contracted port of loading is Nhava Sheva - a different origin needs prior customer approval
